name: Anna's Archive (title to MD5 via the search page)

search.description: Load the public search page in a real tab and return the result cards as {md5, ext, size, year, text}. Exists because the CLI's HTML search gets a 403 anti-bot challenge on every mirror; a browser tab clears it. Reuses an open annas-archive.gl tab so the challenge cookie carries across calls.

lang.description: AA lang filter, default en (soft ranking hint)

probe.description: Diagnostic. Navigate to a search and sample the page once a second (href, readyState, card count, first card texts). Use when search() returns rows that do not match the query.

resolve.description: Map a list of titles to one MD5 each (best epub whose card text contains every significant title word, else first epub, else first row). Returns pick text and up to 3 alternatives per title so misses can be eyeballed before spending annas-fetch quota. The download itself stays in ops-toolkit tools/annas-fetch (member key via op run).
